newsitem.title: CANADA: RCMP says reviewing Strathcona report on Busang.
newsitem.headline: RCMP says reviewing Strathcona report on Busang.

text.p: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) said on Monday that it received a copy of Strathcona Mineral Services Ltd's damning report on the Busang gold project and that investigators were reviewing it.
"Bre-X has given us a copy of the report and our investigators are reviewing that (report)," Deleen Schoff, a spokeswoman for the RCMP's K Division in Alberta, said in a telephone interview.

The Busang discovery -- touted by Calgary-based Bre-X Minerals Ltd as the richest find of the century -- was falsified on a scale "without precedent in the history of mining," according to the report by Strathcona issued late on Sunday.
Bre-X said on Sunday the report would be passed on to the "appropriate authorities."
Schoff said investigators with the RCMP's criminal crime unit were only reviewing the Strathcona report at this stage.
"I can't speculate on what they're going to do after they read the report," she said.
